decisions.statement: A locked buy rule is refused unless the call says `--force`.
The id is said as a word and going on past the lock at its flag.
A call saying no id is refused though it says to go on past the lock.
A flag this takes none of is refused, naming both the ways this is said.
Going on past the lock carries no value, so a value joined to it is refused.
A `--` makes even a flag this does take the id rather than that flag.
An id no buy rule has refuses the call.

definition: the command taking away a buy rule named by its id
